what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Nigeria in South Africa: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 1306 Nigerian asylum seekers in South Africa, 2.3% of all asylum seekers from Nigeria.
Refugees from Nigeria, a separate group, live mostly in Niger, Cameroon, Chad and Italy.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Nigeria with JAS in 2009 and from 2011 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group from 2015 to 2025.
It also records armed conflict over Northern Nigeria territory in 2004.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2000 at 1036 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 10713, at the end of 2015; the main years of displacement in the data include 2017 to 2020.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in South Africa.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for South Africa only.
